text_model: Enhanced word+char TF-IDF + calibrated LinearSVC trained on SDCNL UMAP-GMM label-corrected labels
speech_model: single-audio acoustic Logistic Regression selected with participant-grouped CV
status: prototype research decision layer; not clinically validated and not jointly calibrated on paired text-speech suicide labels
rationale: Text receives higher weight because SDCNL directly models suicide/depression language. The primary text model is trained on SDCNL-style confidence-corrected labels. EATD models SDS-derived depression/distress. No paired ground truth exists to learn multimodal fusion weights.
